findings.title: Remove or substantiate 八’s current “all around; all sides” sense
findings.details: The article marks “all around; all sides” as an established current Chinese sense and generates a `has_sense` edge, but the cited imported gloss list and dictionary summary do not verify that exact current gloss. The dictionary summary supports modern “many” or “in many directions.” Both factual and readability reviews identified this defect; no corrective revision is shown.
findings.verification: Revise the sense and generated edge to match the cited current Chinese evidence, or add inspected present-day Chinese dictionary evidence for the exact gloss; then obtain fresh factual and readability approvals.
